_comment: Elden Ring SB_KG glyph -> Dark Souls 3 KG_PS4_* slot.
Indices are into the output of segment_glyphs.py run on ER's menu/hi/01_common.tpf.dcx SB_KG.
DS3 slot naming, which is not obvious: L_* is the D-PAD cluster and R_* is the FACE BUTTON cluster.
DS3's PlayStation set follows the Japanese convention: OK is Circle, Cancel is Cross. Do not swap these.
D-pad pairs were matched by measuring which arms are lit, not by eye. ER ships two complete sets of
seven d-pads, a bright white-filled set and a dark outlined set; DS3 highlights the active direction,
so the bright set is correct. Lit arms measure ~173 vs ~64 for unlit, which separates them cleanly.
07_pill is a DERIVED asset: ER merges the OPTIONS word and its button pill into one component, so it
is split at y=30 where row occupancy steps from ~82px wide (text) to ~26px (pill).
TP_L and TP_R are deliberately ABSENT. ER ships a single touchpad symbol, not a left/right pair, and
using it for both would erase the distinction DS3 needs. Those two slots stay vanilla.
